rationale: Every supplied artifact use accurately preserves the claim's scope, methodology stages, and explicit limitations. The artifacts consistently present AMLAS as a public six-stage research methodology limited to the ML component (primarily offline supervised learning), emphasize that it requires complementary system and domain assurance, and never represent it as a regulator-issued means of compliance or whole-vehicle/aircraft approval.
limitations: Review is bounded by the excerpted text of the supplied artifacts in the packet; unsupplied portions of long artifacts were not evaluated.
